meta.title: Manage Line Items: Save fails when Quantity exceeds maximum allowed digits
gaps: The Manage Line Items drawer's exact response when saving quantity 9999999999 after entering price 1200, including whether it saves or which validation message appears.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The Manage Line Items drawer's exact response when saving quantity 9999999999 after entering price 1200, including whether it saves or which validation message appears.

steps.note: Create the saved eRFX draft needed as the starting state.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Create the initial line item so the draft has an Items 1 control.
Complete the pricing sheet for the initial line item.
Commit a schedule so the draft can be saved.
Complete the draft's required participant setup.
Save the eRFX as a draft.
Navigate to the events list to locate the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Assert that the newly saved draft appears in the draft list.
Reopen this plan's saved draft on its create screen.

args.goal: On the saved eRFX draft, open the Items 1 Manage Line Items window, select a product from its product dropdown, enter 9999999999 in Quantity, enter 1200 in Price, click Save, and stop with the resulting save or validation outcome visible.

steps.note: Perform the exact Manage Line Items interaction and record the application's response, which no catalog assertion can specifically judge.
Assert that the line-item management screen remains visibly available after the interaction.
